WITH revenue_by_nation AS (
    SELECT
        n.n_name,
        SUM(l.l_extendedprice * (1 - l.l_discount)) AS total_revenue
    FROM
        orders o
    JOIN
        customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
    JOIN
        nation n ON c.c_nationkey = n.n_nationkey
    JOIN
        lineitem l ON o.o_orderkey = l.l_orderkey
    WHERE
        o.o_orderdate >= '1993-01-01'
        AND o.o_orderdate <= '1993-12-31'
        AND l.l_shipmode = 'RAIL'
    GROUP BY
        n.n_name
)
SELECT
    n_name,
    total_revenue
FROM
    revenue_by_nation
WHERE
    total_revenue > (SELECT AVG(total_revenue) FROM revenue_by_nation)
ORDER BY
    total_revenue DESC,
    n_name ASC

SELECT
    strftime(l.l_shipdate, '%Y-%m') AS shipment_year_month,
    SUM(l.l_quantity) AS total_quantity,
    SUM(l.l_extendedprice) AS total_revenue
FROM
    lineitem l
JOIN
    orders o ON l.l_orderkey = o.o_orderkey
JOIN
    customer c ON o.o_custkey = c.c_custkey
JOIN
    part p ON l.l_partkey = p.p_partkey
WHERE
    c.c_mktsegment = 'FURNITURE'
    AND p.p_type LIKE '%TIN%'
    AND l.l_shipdate >= '1995-01-01'
    AND l.l_shipdate <= '1995-12-31'
GROUP BY
    shipment_year_month
ORDER BY
    shipment_year_month ASC

    c.c_custkey,
    c.c_nationkey,
    SUM(o.o_totalprice) AS total_order_price
  FROM customer c
  JOIN orders o ON c.c_custkey = o.o_custkey

JOIN region r ON n.n_regionkey = r.r_regionkey
GROUP BY r.r_name
ORDER BY avg_customer_total DESC, r.r_name ASC
